column1: # Tab separated. Lines starting with # are ignored.
#   id        short name, also the sub-folder name on the USB drive
#   category  folder on the USB drive: linux | windows | diagnostics | rescue | security | misc
#   mode      index  = scrape a directory listing, take the newest match
#             github = newest release asset from a GitHub repo
#             manual = you must download it by hand (licence or no stable URL)
#   source    directory URL (index) | owner/repo (github) | file URL (direct) | home page (manual)
#   pattern   regex for the file name (index/github), "-" otherwise
#   sums      checksum file name inside the same directory (index), URL (direct), or "-"
#   enabled   yes | no   -> "no" is skipped by `make fetch`
